function_v0.doc:
Swap on `pool` only if the classic leg already delivered.

* `user` \xe2\x80\x94 the inventory account; must authorize (tx source).
* `expect_asset` \xe2\x80\x94 SAC of the asset the classic leg should have delivered.
* `expect_min_balance` \xe2\x80\x94 guard: balance(user, expect_asset) >= this.
* `pool` \xe2\x80\x94 Aquarius pool.
* `token_in` \xe2\x80\x94 asset the swap spends (the pool pulls it from `user`;
not used in the call itself, kept in the ABI so the invocation args
carry everything an offline auth builder needs).
* `in_idx`/`out_idx` \xe2\x80\x94 token indices in the pool.
* `in_amount`/`out_min` \xe2\x80\x94 swap amount / min out (the pool enforces out_min).

Returns the pool swap's amount out.
function_v0.name: swap_if
